def evaluate_with_threshold(test_data,threshold):
    automatic=[r for r in test_data if r[4]>=threshold]
    correct_auto=sum(r[2]==r[3] for r in automatic)
    auto_accuracy=correct_auto/len(automatic) if automatic else 0
    coverage=len(automatic)/len(test_data) if test_data else 0
    return auto_accuracy,coverage
